## Rule Cheat Sheet (enforced by the validator)

Use this as a **pre-extraction checklist** against your `buildPack` output — the validator
catches every rule below, but catching E4/E11/W2 before `node $SK extract` saves a full
re-run cycle. Rules most commonly tripped by archetype:

- **Chinese-name-reference libraries (Pattern B)** → E4, E5, E13
- **Collection / monolith libraries** → E11, W2, W4
- **Multi-stage libraries with overlay data** → E7, E12
- **Libraries with prose `contents`** → E13

### Collection / monolith library pre-flight gate (MUST pass before extract)

Collection libraries fail downstream most often because of asset / homogeneity drift, not
schema errors. Run these checks **before** `node $SK extract` — they catch what E11/W2/W4
flag but agents commonly miss when validate exits 0 in a non-strict run:

1. **Stat every registered asset path** on disk (W2). For each entry in `assets`, run
   `fs.existsSync(resolve(meta.assetBase, path))`; bare filenames must be resolved against
   `meta.assetBase` first. Any miss blocks green until the file is added or the entry removed.
2. **Verify item-group homogeneity**: every "repeated item" block that `templatize` collapses
   into a single template must share structure across instances. A giant catch-all slot
   means the group is heterogeneous — split it into per-shape components before extracting.
3. **Walk every entity, look up its referenced local assets**, and confirm each is listed in
   `assets` (E11). Do not rely on `validate` alone — orphan assets inside entities fail E11
   only under `--strict`; without it, validate can exit 0 while downstream consumers hit
   404s.
4. **Keep engine ids as data** (Elementor eids, data-attrs, custom DOM markers). Templatize
   must not drop them; W4 fires when an asset is registered but never referenced because
   the engine id that anchored the reference was lost during parameterization.

If any of these four checks fails, fix and re-run — do not declare green on validate-exit-0
alone.

| Rule | Meaning |
|---|---|
| E1 | `schemaVersion` must be present and supported (current: `1.2`/`1.3`) |
| E2 | `meta.id` is required and must be a valid slug |
| E3 | `entities` is required and non-empty; each entity needs `kind` + the per-kind name field (`name` by default, see `kindNameFields`) |
| E4 | every `aliases` value must be an existing entity id — **hand-written idMaps must be cross-checked: `Object.keys(pack.entities).includes(id)` for every value** |
| E5 | every `relations[*].a`/`b` (after alias resolution) must exist in entities — **crawled-name mismatches explode here** |
| E6 | `relations[*].type` must be registered in `relationTypes` |
| E7 | every id reference in `stages[*].entities` and `stages[*].relations[*].{a,b}` must exist in entities |
| E8 | `stages[*].layout[*]` coordinates must be in `[0,1]` (normalized) |
| E10 | attribute-pair labels (in `[label, value, ...]` or `{label,...}` form) must be registered in `attributeTypes` |
| E11 | every local asset path referenced by entities/contents must be listed in `assets` — **bare filenames are resolved via `meta.assetBase`; http(s)/`data:` URIs are exempt** |
| E12 | when multiple edges share `(a,b)`, a stage's `{a,b}` ref must resolve to exactly one edge via `scope` (or `type`) |
| E13 | `contents[*].highlights[*].ref` must resolve to an entity/alias/`domain.notes` key — **wrong entity names in prose are caught** |
| E14 | both ids in every `sameAs` pair must exist |
| E15 | every key in `provenance.entities`/`relations`/`contents` must point at a real record |
| E16 | `derivations[*]` must have a valid `kind` enum, a resolvable `source` path (E), non-empty `consumers`, and non-empty `note` |
| W1 | entity has no inbound/outbound reference anywhere — consider adding to a stage or removing |
| W2 | asset registered in `assets` but file missing on disk — **collection libraries: stat every registered path before claiming green** |
| W3 | relation edge has no `label` |
| W4 | asset registered but unreferenced — **collection libraries: confirm engine ids kept as data, do not let templatize drop them** |
